title: Identification and Estimation of Staggered Difference-in-Differences with Network Spillovers
abstract: arXiv:2605.15119v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper studies staggered difference-in-differences designs in which treated and comparison units can be exposed to other units' adoption. Using an exposure mapping specified by the researcher, we define realized and counterfactual exposure states and decompose the total effect into a switching effect of own adoption and a spillover effect under no own adoption. Conditional parallel trends identify the total and switching effects by matching, respectively, the counterfactual and realized exposure states of the treated cohort to the same states among units that never adopt. The difference between these effects identifies the spillover effect for the treated cohort. We construct outcome regression estimators for these effects and doubly robust estimators for the total and switching effects, and establish their asymptotic normality under spatial dependence. Monte Carlo simulations assess finite-sample bias, RMSE, pointwise coverage,

translated_title: 具有网络溢出效应的交错双重差分设计的识别与估计
translated_abstract: 本文研究交错双重差分设计中处理单位与对照单位可能暴露于其他单位政策采用（处理）的情形。利用由研究者设定的暴露映射，我们定义了实现的暴露状态与反事实暴露状态，并将总效应分解为自身采用的切换效应以及在无自身采用情形下的溢出效应。通过将处理组群的反事实暴露状态与实现的暴露状态分别匹配到从未采用单位中的相同状态，条件平行趋势假设即可识别总效应与切换效应；二者之差则识别出处理组群的溢出效应。我们为这些效应构造了结果回归估计量，并为总效应和切换效应构造了双重稳健估计量，同时在空间依赖性下建立了这些估计量的渐近正态性。蒙特卡洛模拟评估了估计量的有限样本偏差、均方根误差（RMSE）、逐点覆盖率等表现。
tldr: 本文提出了在存在网络溢出的交错双重差分设计中，利用暴露映射将总效应分解为自身采用的切换效应与溢出效应，借助条件平行趋势实现识别，并构造了在空间依赖下渐近正态的双重稳健估计量。
en_tdlr: This paper develops identification and (doubly robust) estimation of staggered difference-in-differences with network spillovers, decomposing the total effect into an own-adoption switching effect and a spillover effect via an exposure mapping, identified through conditional parallel trends and asymptotically normal under spatial dependence.
